'''Frank Lamantia'''<ref name="dt-11708">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11708 Frank's Hunt Down v1 1], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 12 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11708/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11708/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018094941/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11708/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''FrankLamanti''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in November 2000.
